{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with 'severe' disease (case-insensitive)
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'].str.lower() == 'severe']

# Check the number of such patients
num_severe = len(severe_patients)

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print results
print("Number of severe patients:", num_severe)
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among severe patients:", mean_biomarker_severe)"}
